flags.summary: The FY2026 Q2 filing reports $11.1 billion of equity consideration and up to $8.5 billion of designated debt payoff in the pending Spectrum transaction, plus future payments under the Spectrum Credit Agreement.
The FY2026 Q2 filing reports substantial related-party equipment-lease debt and related interest expense with Valor Equity Partners, alongside material purchases from Tesla.
The FY2026 Q2 filing reports major pending acquisitions and transaction-related obligations that could materially recontextualize the period.

narratives.narrative: The quarter reported revenue of $4.071 billion against expenses of $4.984 billion and a net loss of $1.008 billion. No cataloged quarter-dated soft-layer currency claim supports an adjustment.

The quarter reported revenue of $7.814 billion against expenses of $7.978 billion and a net loss of $541 million. It also reported $327 million of three-month interest expense tied to related-party equipment leases, with $2.039 billion of current and $11.290 billion of long-term related-party lease debt, while pending Spectrum and Cursor transactions remained conditional.
